title: project/AGENTS.md forbids all project/ edits; wiki is the exception
description:
Researcher first-pass.

project/AGENTS.md says DO NOT EDIT HERE and \"Editing anything under project/ directly is hacking the data.\" CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md says wiki markdown under project/wiki/ is the exception.

Agents read the nearer file and refuse to write pages.

Product rule: project/AGENTS.md must name project/wiki/*.md as the allowed exception (same sentence as the sin). CONTRIBUTING remains the long form.

comments.author: ryan
